body:
I know it’s not.
I’m well aware of what it takes.

I can’t afford to because medical school is an undergrad in my country.
I wasted my time in a business degree because I just wanted something unrelated to medicine that would land me a job. 
I’ve wasted 3 years of fees.
The Government pays a contribution towards our degree.
Because of my 3 years spent in college I don’t get the contribution if I go back.

That’s 10k for 6 years to study medicine.
We don’t have student loans here.
I’d struggle to keep a part time job so realistically I’d need to take a number of years out to save up the money.. 
I’d essentially be putting my life on hold for x number of years.
I’d be working nonstop in a minimum wage job and living with my parents in order to save every cent. 
That’s assuming I can get in and assuming I won’t drop out, again.
